fields.description: Skyvue Solair is the first tower in Sobha’s Skyvue collection at Sobha Hartland 2. Its triangular plan produces several apartment shapes and orientations, from compact one-bedroom homes to larger layouts with study/store space. The current project page also mentions three-bedroom residences, while the retrieved launch plans detail the smaller types.

overview: A one-bedroom study layout is marketed as 1.5 bedrooms in the launch pack. Its drawing labels the extra space study/store. Larger two-bedroom plans vary materially in shape, so floor position and usable room layout are more informative than a generic project size range.
research.locationNote: The official page places Solair within Sobha Hartland 2 in Dubai. Skyline, lagoon and Ras Al Khor views depend on floor and orientation.
research.priceLabel: Developer website selection guide · reconfirm scope
research.priceNote: The current official enquiry section displays AED 5.83m subject to inventory availability. Property Finder retains an original AED 1.28m reference (rounded headline 1.3m). The large difference is unresolved for a specific release or unit; the website selection guide is not a universal entry price or confirmed quotation.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder reports 20% booking, 40% construction and 40% handover. These aggregate stages are secondary information, not a current signed calendar. Confirm the unit’s due dates, transfer balances and extra charges.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder reports March 2029, shown as Q1 2029. The official brochure does not establish an individual contractual completion date. Conflicting dates in resale adverts are not adopted.
